title: Build an AI CRM and Website for $5 a Month
description:
This video shows you how to get an all-in-one CRM and website with AI agents for just $5 a month.

It replaces tools like Go High Level and can be controlled by voice. The AI assistant, Nova, can manage contacts, appointments, tasks, and sales summaries. You can also host courses and memberships inside the app. It's fully built and ready to download.

App building workshop this Saturday. Comment CLAUDE to get tickets.

#AI #CRM #WebsiteBuilder
